comment: The arm outputs are left without a family because each arm's mode switch changes them between modulation and drum gates. No source is published for this plugin. The Speed submenu's own choices are built at runtime from a 1/ prefix and a number; 1/100 and x10 are the only two named outright, so the line gives the range rather than the full list. The menu item prints with a question mark, Wave Arms?, although the maker's manual calls it Wave Arms.
